notes: A subject federate actively subscribes to one adapter-selected application interaction class and passively subscribes to the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation class from the adapter-supplied IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. A separate requester queries the subject using HLArequestSubscriptions. The test verifies that the standard HLAinteractionClassList contains exactly both classes with their distinct active/passive states, while the empty directed-interaction report remains a correctly shaped NULL response. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM content, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, application interaction name, and update-rate designator remain adapter supplied. No vendor API, private headers, or DDM regions are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, bool active = true) = 0
